messages:
jordan-release: deploy-bot denied prod deploy: Permission denied: missing role 'release-signer' — trying to push v2026.04.1-canary, anyone with signer rights online?

deploy-bot: ERROR: insufficient_permissions - requires role=release-signer or a delegated-proxy token. See https://redwood.internal/runbooks/deploy-roles#delegated-proxy
maria-dev: I can sign but I'm on PTO until 14:00 PT. Is there an approved fallback for an emergency canary?
kevin-eng: We use a short-lived deployer-proxy pattern for cross-team cases. SecOps can mint a token: `authz create-proxy --scope=release-signer --ttl=1h` — only SecOps has the ability to run that.
lisa-security: I can create the proxy token. Need the PR link, tag, and confirmation this is within the change window.
jordan-release: PR: github.com/redwood/release/changes/1429 tag `v2026.04.1-canary`. Change window is open (23:00-02:00 UTC) and this is a low-risk canary.
sre-oncall: FYI we saw elevated tail latency on yesterday's canary; agreed rollback plan is to return to `v2026.03.9` if any regressions. Jenkins job `release/rollback --to=v2026.03.9` is ready.
lisa-security: Granting a 1h deployer-proxy token for @jordan-release. I'll DM the token and log the action. :lock:
jordan-release: Received token. Re-running deploy: `deploy-bot trigger --tag v2026.04.1-canary --auth TOKEN-XXXX`
deploy-bot: Deploy started: canary on infra-pool-7. Streaming logs... (first logs show boot + model load ok)
kevin-eng: :thumbsup: monitor QPS and error-rate (SLOs: p99 < 120ms, error < 0.5%). If we need to rollback: `./scripts/rollback.sh v2026.03.9` and ping #incidents.
maria-dev: Thanks @lisa-security — please add a note in the release notes about using a delegated proxy for signing.
lisa-security: Logged action in runbook and ticket INF-881: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/deploy-roles#delegated-proxy — actioned by lisa-security, token ttl=1h.
sre-oncall: Monitoring dashboards show healthy metrics at +10m. Keep an eye on embeddings throughput and tail latency.
jordan-release: Canary healthy at 20m. Proceeding to staggered rollout: 10% -> 50% -> 100% per runbook. I'll update release notes with deploy details and the fallback plan.
kevin-eng: Reminder to pin infra model to avoid auto-upgrade drift: `infractl pin-model --service=realtime --model=m-lm-1.3-q4 --tag=v2026.04.1-canary`
jordan-release: Pin applied. Final note: post-rollout checklist will be trivial but I'll file a short post-release note with metrics and any action items.
maria-dev: Awesome, thanks everyone.
